tryLock.clause: // ends_only_if (default false): this action may end no acquisition. ensures forall qt: Int :: { tok(qt).gHeld }
// unbacked_only_if tryLock_unbacked_only_on_cap_refusal (sidecar, reviewed) ensures res != NULL && !tok(res).gBacked ==> (rej)
ensures res != NULL && has(S, k) && carried(S, k, res) ==>

unLock.clause: // ends_only_if unLock_ends_only_presented_token (sidecar, reviewed) ensures forall qt: Int :: { tok(qt).gHeld }
ensures old(carried(S, k, t)) ==> res && !has(S, k)

sweep.clause: // ends_only_if sweep_ends_only_expired (sidecar, reviewed) ensures forall qt: Int :: { tok(qt).gHeld }
ensures old(has(S, k)) && old(S.m[k].expiresAt) <= now ==> !has(S, k)
ensures old(has(S, k)) && now < old(S.m[k].expiresAt) ==> has(S, k)
